title: Hollow and Garden
author: Quentin Underhill
blurb: Ivo Almeida, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
